business_id.title: Business Id
business_id.description: ID of current business making the call. The current biz user must be collaborator, admin or owner of this business.

partner_ids.title: Partner Ids
partner_ids.description: IDs of the businesses to create partnerships with. The current biz user must be collaborator, admin or owner of these businesses.

group_ids.title: Group Ids
group_ids.description: IDs of the groups that the invited business will have express access to.

weekly_distributes.title: Weekly Distributes
weekly_distributes.description: Weekly amount of total times other business can distribute treets to your groups. If set to None, there will be no limit.
